recent.title: Headquarters data has two sources
recent.summary: The dashboard loads headquarters-data.json for UI content (Atlas's Brief, recommendations, waiting items) and dash.json for pipeline/activity data. Updating only dash.json via dash-update.py left the UI unchanged. Lesson: any HQ update touching the main recommendation/waiting/health panels must update headquarters-data.json directly.

recent.title: Canonical Reproduction Failure
recent.summary: Approved emails were changed during implementation. Root cause: no separation between canonical assets and execution. Fixed with send-canonical.py, Protected Assets, and mandatory Technical Verification.
